figurative_meaning_en: One's lifelong activities or the entire course of one's life
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই লীলাখেলা শেষ হলে সবাই শান্তি পাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His life's play is still going on.
Once this life's drama ends, everyone will find peace.
history: The term 'লীলা' draws from Hindu religious contexts referring to divine pastimes, extended metaphorically to human life in Bengali folklore and literature.
note: Often used to imply the transient nature of life, akin to a divine game.
